profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Java, Scala, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, AWS, GCP | Public Trust Clearance | US Citizen | AWS Certified
profile.jobTitle: Backend Java Developer / Sr. Software Developer
profile.summary:
Backend Software Engineer with 7+ years of extensive experience designing, scaling, and modernizing high-throughput distributed systems and enterprise microservices within the fintech and federal healthcare domains.

I specialize in building resilient, production-grade architectures using Java, Scala, and Spring Boot, paired with event-driven streaming and cloud-native infrastructure. Whether implementing toggle-based migration strategies, optimizing data pipelines, or ensuring strict regulatory compliance, my focus is writing clean, maintainable code that solves complex architectural bottlenecks.

Core Technical Stack:
🔹 Languages & Frameworks: Java, Scala, Spring Boot, Quarkus, RESTful APIs, Microservices
🔹 Data & Messaging: Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Oracle
🔹 Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CI/CD

Career Highlights:
• Enterprise & Federal Systems (SparkSoft, Deloitte, TCS): Delivered scalable backend services, modernized legacy platforms, and engineered high-reliability data workflows for mission-critical applications.
• Cloud & AI Certified: Earned both the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and AWS Certified AI Practitioner credentials, bridging core cloud infrastructure with modern Generative AI, RAG, and foundation model capabilities.

What I’m Looking For:
I am currently open to new opportunities in Backend Software Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Cloud-Native Development (remote or flexible roles). I thrive in collaborative engineering cultures tackling complex architectural challenges.

📩 Let’s Connect: Feel free to message me directly here on LinkedIn if you’re hiring, want to talk backend architecture, or would like to connect!

positions.title: Backend Java Developer / Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented toggle-based migration strategies, enabling seamless transitions from legacy to modern business rules with zero downtime and guaranteed backward compatibility across multi-state deployments.  
• Engineered and verified eligibility processing platforms using Scala, handling complex validation logic and type-safe data mappings across distributed microservice architectures.  
• Achieved high test coverage by building comprehensive integration test suites using JUnit and Mockito, maintaining 100% pass rates for critical backend components.  
• Resolved complex merge conflicts, optimized external API integration layers, and enforced regression testing with over 230+ automated checks.  
• Refactored core modules to support new functional requirements, optimizing timer lifecycles, cloud client configurations, and dynamic API endpoints.

Environment: Scala, Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Bruno, Redis, Kafka, JSON, XML, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Agile/Scrum, Claude Code, Unix, Jira

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Proficient in deploying, managing, and optimizing high-performance distributed systems. Skilled in Java, Python, REST APIs, and cloud-native design principles. 
• Led a team in designing and implementing the Correspondence Module for Illinois and Virginia’s Integrated Eligibility System (IES), ensuring multilingual support for 2M+ users.
• Led end-to-end architecture design for a containerized (Docker/Kubernetes) application on AWS, ensuring DoD compliance and scalability for 2M+ users.
• Implemented a fault-tolerant message queueing system with RabbitMQ, developing asynchronous messaging using Java for inter-service communication and improving data processing efficiency.
• Automated CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) with IaC templates (Terraform), reducing deployment time by 30% and enabling zero-downtime updates.
• Implemented AMQP message sending and receiving functionality on RabbitMQ, handling synchronous and asynchronous communication.
• Engineered 20+ RESTful APIs with Spring Boot to integrate frontend and backend systems, enhancing module performance.
• Facilitated microservice integration with RabbitMQ for asynchronous communication and event-driven processing.
• Optimized SQL queries and PL/SQL procedures, reducing database latency by 15% and improving JDBC call efficiency.
• Developed and maintained software solutions using Java, Oracle SQL, and IBM ClearCase within Agile/Scrum teams, ensuring smooth application transitions and system reliability.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Languages: Java, Python, Bash, PL/SQL
• Frameworks & Tools: Spring Boot, J2EE, Flask, REST APIs, JSP, Servlets,  Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis
• Cloud Platforms: Oracle Cloud (OCI), AWS, GCP
• Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, Terraform, Linux
• Databases: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
• Methodologies: Agile/Scrum, TDD, SDLC, CI/CD
• Other: Jira, ServiceNow, IBM ClearCase, Object-Oriented Design, Network Programming
positions.insights: Problem-Solving in High-Stakes Environments, Cross-Functional Collaboration and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tata Consultancy Services 
- Coordinate with all the teams to maintain knowledge on all SCRUM requirements and ensure compliance to all architecture standards in the project.
- Involved in analyzing, designing, implementing and testing of the project and requirements.
- Worked on User Group access and Parent and Child Relation throughout the application using Spring Boot and Data JPA.
- Used various features of Angular 7 like data binding, custom pipes, routing, custom directives, string interpolation, dynamic  binding to meet custom requirements.
- Used Angular 7, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3to build (SPA) Single Page application.
- Created Stored Procedures on MySQL to manipulate the database and used Hibernate to apply the business logic according to the user's specifications.
- Designed REST templates to send the requests from one microservices to another.
- Creation of shell scripts for the generation of reports.
- Managing pipelines of CI/CD with Jenkins
- Designed and developed component and module based responsive user interfaces using ANGULAR 6, Javascript, CSS, and HTML framework.

projects.title: Web Application Firewall : Amazon Web Service
projects.description:
•Developed a WebApp with the use of HTML, Bootstrap, and Java technologies. 
•Migrated Web app resource in Simple Storage Service and connected to Cloud Front with routing to the Route 53 domain. 
•Launch Web Application Firewall to block against various attacks such as SQL injection, HTTP flood, Knower IP attack & Bot Scrapper attack. 
•Performed automation testing on Web Application using Selenium tool.

projects.title: Face Detection And Facial Expression Recognition
projects.description:
• Studied research paper Real Time Face Detection and Facial Expression Recognition: Development and
Applications to Human Computer Interaction based on Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligent and generate term paper under Artificial Intelligent course.
• Performed various practical with the help of MATLAB.
